TEXT:
A few days later. We have gathered in the 
clubroom once again, conducting a meeting.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Yo Kousaka, sorry about before.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I blame the both of you, Sena's delusions just 
wouldn't stop, it was a disaster.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Sorry, Kousaka-senpai. He said he really wanted to 
go and wouldn't take no for an answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: I'm truly sorry to you as well, Akagi-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Oh I'm fine. I went home after that and-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I drew some art of Makabe-senpai at the beach, 
orgasming from the forced humiliation play by the club 
president. After I put it online, I was completely calm.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: You took out some crazy revenge on us!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That artwork... Even though it was temporary, it 
caught everyone's attention and topped the 
rankings. And I was wondering if it might be you...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
For a joke, a lot of people are taking notice of it, I 
never imagined this going viral so quickly.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: It went viral!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Across the digital sea, it'll spread to fujoshis 
worldwide... and continue for all eternity...

Scary...... Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, let 
alone a rotten one... I'll keep that in mind.

Excitement boiled over after such peaceful (?) 
topics. I present the Game Research Club.

The main members are the Club President Miura, 
second-year Makabe-kun, Sena, Kuroneko and me.

Well, there are other members but they hardly 
ever turn up, the infamous "ghost members".

The president and I are third-year students, but he's been 
failing to graduate for a while now. There's no one better at 
making kusoge (shitty games). Basically? A hopeless otaku.

Makabe-kun is polite to anyone and is an all-around 
friendly guy.

And then there's Kuroneko who joined the club 
alongside me, as well as the strange rival of 
Kuroneko, Sena...

With members like these gathering for a game 
development meeting, of course things won't go as 
smoothly as one would think.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Okay everyone, we will now commence the 
meeting regarding the creation of a new game for 
the Autumn Cultural Festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Hmmm, this time the game is... that one RPG idea 
Sena had that failed, you want to make that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Isn't that a hardcore BL game? If such a thing 
were ever made, chaos and calamities would reign 
throughout the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Don't just dismiss it right off the bat, Gokou-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Even I have thought about why it failed previously, 
so this time I thought we'd go with softcore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It... It's not a matter of it being hardcore or softcore, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Ummm, Akagi-san. I feel there is a bit of a problem 
with making a BL game for the school's cultural 
festival...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[font_size=28]But, I know there has to be demand for 
one![/font_size] People all over the world accepted 
my artwork of Makabe-senpai, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
This time, if we base the main character off 
Makabe-senpai, make the stuff installed in him more 
softcore...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: I-Installed?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Come on now, that thing you and the president are 
always doing, you know that.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[font_size=31]That's only in your delusional world! 
We don't always do stuff like that![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: So that means... sometimes...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Not sometimes, not ever! We have never done, nor 
will ever do that!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
How could you?! He can't even get a reward after 
devoting his entire self to you, don't you pity 
Makabe-senpai?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
My gut feeling is that he's the type to scream, so 
I'd recommend lightly gagging him with a towel. 
The considerate top you are, my president!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Um... C...  [font_size=18]Can I cry just a little...[/font_size]

This isn't good. Sena has gone completely wild 
polluting Makabe's mind.

Once she loses self-control, her fujoshi delusions 
comes pouring out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey Sena, keep your delusions down during the 
meet-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Come to think of it, how do you usually do it when 
you're role-playing with Onii-chan? The walls at my 
home are pretty thin, after all?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I said we didn't do anything besides studying!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Oh you, I eavesdrop using the wall sometimes, but 
there's only complete silence?! You should teach 
your secrets to Makabe-senpai as a fellow bottom!!

Wait, she stopped harassing Makabe-kun, but she's 
now bothering me?!

Ugh, I didn't want to resort to this, but there's no 
other choice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, cut it out Sena.  [font_size=33]If you don't, 
I'm gonna rub your breasts.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Hiii!? [font_size=31]You plan on plunging your face 
into my breasts again?[/font_size]

...For a moment, time completely stopped in the 
clubroom.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Y-You're joking, right? Akagi-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
It's no joke, some time ago when it was just the 
two of us, Kousaka-senpai jumped at my...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]Y-You! What are you even saying!? You'll 
cause some weird misunderstandings![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: D-Don't look at me like that, Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Well aren't you two getting along just fine? "Older 
brother of Kirino".
She's putting distance between us all of a sudden?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No wait, let me explain.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
...Senpai...? Won't you tell me in detail what's going 
on...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
H-Hey! What's with that "I'm about to die" 
expression?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Today, my stress is at max... Did I 
really do something that bad?  
[font_size=33]Huh?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Anyway you guys, just listen to me! That was an 
accident...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Hey now, give others a chance to talk, Sena-chi. 
Everyone's involved in making a game together, 
right?

Huh. Well well, what a surprise, I never thought the 
president would actively stop her delusions.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
On that note, I have a suggestion... How about you 
two work together and make a game?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Aren't Gokou's aesthetics and lore compatible with 
Sena's favorite BL games? That sort of thing is 
popular even in Maschera...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [font_size=44]No way.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
My beloved, noble, and beautiful world, being 
eroded by her depraved thoughts... I can't bear to 
witness it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Given the chance, Maschera would be swarmed 
with a bunch of rotting corpses.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm also against it!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
It's really annoying to have a certain evil-eyed 
chuuni girl enter my world!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Oh... Describing such a person with the phrase I 
detest the most... Dare I ask who she is?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I'm think she's really close... Perhaps 
right-in-front-of-me! This evil-eyed chuuni girl!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Not just once, but twice... You really do plan on 
using those words 'til the very end to insult me. 
Very well, I will cast upon you my strongest curse.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Guys, don't fight, come on...

It looks like... the president's suggestion just made 
things worse...

And so, the meeting ended, not with a bang but 
with a whimper, absolutely zero progress.

The closing speech? "Everyone think of some ideas 
for the next meeting."
